title: My Sassy Girl (bc30 x KCC)

title_lang.zh_hk: 我的野蠻女友 (bc30 x KCC)

synopsis: A nightmare begins when a kind-hearted, naive college student encounters a beautiful yet hopelessly drunk young woman who later becomes his sassy girlfriend. With violent punches and bizarre antics, she humiliates him in every possible way, at every turn. Yet he still believes in an undercurrent of genuine goodness beneath her chaotic exterior. Once the highest-grossing comedy of its time in Korea, My Sassy Girl sees Jeon Ji-hyun, fresh off the breakout success of Il Mare, delivers a star-making performance.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 還用多說嗎？縱使不是第一部在香港賣座的韓片，卻無庸置疑是奠定韓流在港地位的中流砥柱。從網絡連載的愛情故事，化為席捲全亞洲的愛情喜劇。當美女遇上戇男，當戇男愛上美女，再野蠻還是最可愛。打者愛也，美女的莫名悲傷和神經質性情，皆源於心底一份莫失莫忘的執念。全智賢繼《觸不到的戀人》後再度風靡萬千影迷，率真演出充滿魅力，教人不問情由為之傾倒。命運柳暗花明，印證了主題曲所言：愛，只要相信就夠了。
